content.title: H&R Block’s (NYSE:HRB) Q3: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: Tax preparation company H&R Block (NYSE:HRB) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5% year on year to $203.6 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $3.89 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $1.20 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
